messages.subject: Thai Union | Global sustainability, responsible sourcing and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Thai Union Leadership Team,

Thai Union's global scale and SeaChange sustainability agenda make the company a strong fit for my experience connecting ESG commitments with operating execution and stakeholder trust.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical experience managing community priorities, regulator engagement, renewable-energy transition and carbon-data readiness across a major industrial operation. My role is built around converting external expectations into clear internal ownership, evidence and executive follow-through.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or international roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or responsible business. I have attached a Thai Union-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
